text:
raj: Noticing a weird churn pattern in ap-southeast1 this morning: lots of 0.25-0.5 GPU pods being scheduled across racks then immediately evicted.

emily: Same here. Eviction reason shows Preemption/gpu. Cluster-autoscaler trimmed a bunch of nodes at 02:10 and warm pool keys got reclaimed.

tao: This started after we turned on fractional-packing-guard (the new safety knob that enforces max-per-pod fractional cap). Seems to scatter tiny pods instead of co-locating them.

nina: Scheduler trace snapshot:
"scheduler: pod \"training-mini-22\" preempted pod \"tiny-worker-101\" on node gpu-asia-17: required=1.0, victims=[0.25,0.25,0.5]"

raj: The victim selection picks small pods across nodes instead of compacting them. When a large job arrives it slices them out one-by-one causing N reschedules.

emily: Also seeing short bursts of egress on those nodes. I suspect sidecar uploads amplify pod startup time so they linger and block packing windows.

tao: Short-term mitigations I propose: 1) roll back fractional-packing-guard in ap-southeast1; 2) change small-pod placement to prefer same-node affinity (best-effort); 3) mark warm-pool instances as lowest preempt priority.

nina: Can ops-bot dump sample eviction logs and autoscaler events?

infra-bot: Autoscaler: scaleDown 8 nodes at 02:11:04 UTC. Evictions on node gpu-asia-17: 6 pods evicted in 5m, reason: Preemption/InsufficientResources(gpu).

raj: After rollback in region churn dropped ~65% on sampled nodes. We'll hold rollback while we prototype a gang-placement admission that batches tiny pods for 8s to encourage local packing.

emily: Follow-ups: simulate heavy large-job arrivals with our scheduler fuzz tests; validate preemption ordering and NIC impact. Also consider a quick sidecar backoff to reduce startup egress.

tao: Longer term: implement fractional placement that reserves contiguous fractional slots on a GPU and makes preemption groups so tiny pods don't get scattered and removed piecemeal.

nina: I'll open infra ticket with churn graphs, cost delta, and tag owners. Leaving region rollback in place for now.

raj: Thanks team. If the churn comes back flag the page and we'll escalate to a temporary admission throttle.
